summary: All requirements met: per-resource TF-IDF+LR models trained and serialised, retrain-on-classify flow confirmed end-to-end, TypeScript compiles clean, frontend wired correctly; two non-blocking findings (undeclared accuracy field in ClassifyResponse type, no dedup guard on classify route).
findings: ClassifyResponse in src/api.ts is missing the 'accuracy' field that POST /api/admin/reviews/{id}/classify returns — add 'accuracy: number | null' to the interface to match the wire shape.

The classify route in main.py inserts a new Prompt row unconditionally with no deduplication check; repeated admin submissions of the same prompt text inflate training_samples without adding new signal — add an existence check by text+resource before inserting, mirroring the idempotency guard in seed_data.py.
